title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Watermelon Ice Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Watermelon Ice offers the taste of juicy, delicately sweet Watermelon balanced with a cool, refreshing exhale. This clean, fruity blend delivers a light and satisfying vape that’s perfect for an all-day flavour. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod contains a 2ml prefilled pod connected to a 10ml refill reservoir, giving 12ml total of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No need for refilling or coil changes—simply connect to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. The dual mesh coil ensures consistent vapour production and flavour for up to 6000 puffs (approx.). Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
